To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we used proteomics to identify 22 proteins that were up-regulated under combination drought and heat stress, and that we found that ABA regulates some of these proteins.
we identified 22 up-regulation proteins and 6 small heat shock proteins in the maize root under combined drought and high temperature stress, and 11 proteins are up-regulated by abscisic acids.
we identified and characterized 22 proteins up-regulated by combined drought and heat stresses in maize roots.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of proteins regulated by drought, heat, and ABA in the roots of maize seedlings.
the identification and characterization of proteins in maize roots under combined drought and high-temperature stress.
the ABA-dependent and -independent regulation of maize root proteins under combined drought and high-temperature stress.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
ABA plays important roles in the regulation of maize root proteins under combined drought and high-temperature stress.
22 proteins were significantly up-regulate in maize root under combined drought and high temperatures stress, among which 11 proteins were ABA dependent.

the 22 upregulated proteins identified in this study are involved in the response of maize roots to combined drought and high temperature stress, and ABA plays important roles in regulating the expression of the up-regulated proteins.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
ABA plays an important role in maize root responses to combined drought and high temperature stress.
drought and heat stress induce a common set of proteins in maize roots.
drought and heat stress induce the accumulation of ABA in maize roots and ABA regulates the accumulation of proteins in response to combined stresses.
The main takeaway from our work is that
ABA plays important roles in maize root response to combined drought/heat stress.
ABA is involved in regulating protein expression in the roots of maize plants subjected to combined drought and high-temperature stress.
ABA regulates several important proteins in the root under combined drought and hot stress.
